custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the blue ink stamp. In AI images, such markings often turn into gibberish or melt into the texture. If the text auditor finds it illegible, consider if this constitutes a minor artifact or just an ambiguous real-world stamp. Also, verify the 'double stitch' structure; AI often fails to render the individual loops of the thread, merging them into a solid red line.
